competing_obligations.derived_consequence_rule: A downstream aggregate failure caused solely by the target violation must be identified as a consequence; any independently sufficient violation remains a competing obligation.

future_isolated_negative_coverage_contra.counting_rule: Count a primary isolated-negative case only when every required evidence element is content-bound and every competing obligation is SATISFIED or NOT_APPLICABLE.

execution_gates.requirement: A separately authorized successor plan binds the immutable M10 historical attestation.
The successor freezes a new immutable study-input snapshot before running any checker.
The unchanged M10 eligibility algorithm is re-applied to the successor input snapshot.
The resulting primary denominator and exploratory set are frozen before execution.
Every primary member has ESTABLISHED authority from a separately governed process.
Every planned case has a content-binding and matched positive-control construction plan.
Competing-obligation analysis is complete or the case is barred from isolated coverage.
Observer profiles, configurations, pipeline stages, and raw-result bindings are fixed.
Campaign budgets, interruption recording, and resumable evidence paths are durably specified.
Normative and exploratory results have separate reports, labels, and percentage calculations.

nonclaims: M10 does not execute Arena, mutation, synthesis, or checker-comparison campaigns.
M10 does not establish any normative authority or approve any authority source.
Readiness feasibility judgments are protocol-design inputs, not semantic evidence or coverage results.
The provisional exploratory set is not a normative denominator and yields no normative percentage.
The empty primary denominator is a valid characterization of the immutable M9 input.
Observer agreement, rejection, or disagreement does not establish normativity or isolation.
No soundness relevance is inferred or assessed by this study design.
